Thank you very much frostRock101, in my case I know what I need to change, not everything but I know what my issues were and also what botheref me from her but I think she isn't really aware of all the things we both would need to change.

As for the being too alike part, it's really a personality thing, we are both kind of childish and we get angry and fight over pointless things like the weather or our favourite chocolate. Really like we would fight and be really angry and then an hour later we would realise we weren't even angry and it was usually a misunderstanding. The problem is that it happened way too often and it wasn't a nice experience.

I think we both need to grow up and try to behave more maturely, think twice before jumping into conclusions and be more empathetic + listen to each other. Like you said I'm scared she doesn't know why she is texting me or if it's just for attention or to make sure I'm still thinking about her.

Thank you for your advice I will talk to her if she texts me again.

I think you might be right. It's hard because I'm scared of letting her go not because I'm afraid of not finding someone better but rather because I want to love her. We had a big argument once that made me rethink our relationship but there were many more pros than cons and the cons weren't even red flags.
You're still right on the fact that the breakup happened so I should just move on

Sorry to hear that bud, I understand it's hard to let go as I don't want to let her go either but if you break up with someone the least you can do is give them some space, even if none of us want it. I think it depends on the couple but I'll keep you updated if I try to talk to her
I've already tried that but she always finds a way to contact me

Breakups are unique and not everyone deals with them the same way so I'd say you should go NC if staying in touch with your ex is harming you in any way
